assertions.name: one_phrase_binds_candidate_identity
assertions.detail: The Agent-prepared request binds a declared alias. The CLI does not parse arbitrary natural language.

assertions.name: identity_rules_survive_costume_change
assertions.detail: This proves instruction binding only, not visual identity or style quality.

assertions.name: new_outfit_and_pose_are_separate_slots
assertions.detail: The pose-only request inherits the default outfit; the raincoat request changes the outfit.

assertions.name: three_candidate_budget_bound
assertions.detail: Candidate count is a director-set task budget, not a ceiling on artistic quality.

assertions.name: original_board_copied_without_editing
assertions.detail: The composite board and candidate identity reference are byte-identical; no crop or image edit was performed.

assertions.name: draft_cannot_be_formal_production
assertions.detail: The unapproved fixture cannot be presented as a production baseline.

assertions.name: review_starts_unknown
assertions.detail: No generated asset or human approval was fabricated.

assertions.name: composition_binds_product_graphic_typography
assertions.detail: One layout task binds its constituent asset categories and the declared product subject.

assertions.name: composition_uses_one_baseline
assertions.detail: All component briefs were compiled against the same package id, version and fingerprint.

assertions.name: composition_retains_identity_and_copy_rules
assertions.detail: Product images, final copy, typography and channel verification remain absent; this is not a finished banner.

assertions.name: editing_draft_does_not_silently_publish
assertions.detail: New tasks read current, not an arbitrary editable draft; current still points to version 0.2.0.

assertions.name: unpublished_budget_still_enforced
assertions.detail: Requesting four candidates fails until the new budget is explicitly adopted.

assertions.name: explicit_adoption_changes_current
assertions.detail: The demo explicitly adopts a candidate. It does not record director approval or a production release.

assertions.name: new_task_reads_latest_adopted_version
assertions.detail: The newly started task uses the current 0.2.1 candidate and its updated budget.

assertions.name: old_task_bytes_unchanged
assertions.detail: All frozen input files are byte-identical before and after adopting the new candidate.

assertions.name: resume_reports_update_without_migration
assertions.detail: Resume verifies old inputs, reports the new current version and does not silently migrate the task.

assertions.name: no_assets_or_approvals_invented
assertions.detail: This run called only local Python CLIs. It made no image-model call, PSD, real delivery or approval.

limitations: Original illustrative character and text-only campaign fixtures; no actual client asset was used.
A structured request is prepared by an Agent. The CLI is not a natural-language parser.
The image is an existing original candidate board, not a newly generated or approved production asset.
These assertions verify routing, inheritance, versioning and truthful states, not face preservation or image quality.
No image generation, Photoshop editing, real team first-pass acceptance or rework-rate experiment was performed.
